Understanding Sunekos

Sunekos is a patented, highly advanced bio-revitalization treatment that regenerates the Extra Cellular Matrix (ECM) of your skin. Unlike traditional dermal fillers that simply add volume, Sunekos contains a specific mix of non-cross-linked Hyaluronic Acid and essential Amino Acids. This unique formulation stimulates the fibroblasts in your skin to produce new collagen and elastin.

It is exceptionally effective for treating delicate areas where traditional fillers are unsuitable, such as the severe dark circles and hollows under the eyes (periorbital area), as well as sun-damaged skin on the face, neck, and décolletage.

Key Benefits

  • Stimulates natural production of collagen and elastin.
  • Significantly reduces dark circles and under-eye bags.
  • Improves deep skin hydration and elasticity.
  • Smooths fine lines and wrinkles naturally.

Suitable Candidates

Ideal for clients wanting to improve skin quality, reduce under-eye dark circles, or treat skin laxity without the use of structural fillers.

Who Should Avoid

  • Pregnant or nursing mothers.
  • Individuals with active skin infections.

The Treatment Journey

1. Step-by-Step Procedure

  1. Numbing: Topical cream is applied for comfort.
  2. Injection: Sunekos is injected superficially into the dermal layer using a specific pattern.
  3. Massage: The area is gently massaged.

Recovery

Mild swelling (especially under the eyes) and small bumps at injection sites usually resolve within 24-48 hours.

Results

A course of 3-4 treatments is required. Results begin to show after the second session, peaking at 4 weeks after the final session.

Maintenance

Results last around 6 months. Maintenance sessions are recommended twice a year.

Risks

Temporary bruising, swelling, and redness at injection sites.

Aftercare

  • Do not massage the treated area.
  • Avoid hot baths and saunas for 24 hours.

FAQs

How is Sunekos different from filler?

Fillers volumize and contour. Sunekos regenerates the skin itself, improving its structure and elasticity from within.
